description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class managing customer options in an e-commerce application. It handles listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting customer options, including multilingual descriptions and permissions.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing customer options including listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting options with multilingual support.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the list of customer options in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific customer option identified by its ID.

methods.name: displayOptionCreate
methods.description: Displays the creation form for a new customer option.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and returns the model with customer option data for editing or creation.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a customer option, including validation and multilingual descriptions.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Provides a paginated JSON list of customer options for the admin interface.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Deletes a customer option by ID with authorization and error handling.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context for the admin interface.
